registration: 14 existing corner controls plus global affine continuation outside their hull; approximate source diagram

source.notes: Official 2026 PDF vector geometry: GA1 purple 10pt stroke, GA2 filled polygon. Registered by the existing 14 geographic corner controls at 1.5px/pt, with global-affine padded hull for continuous extrapolation. Diagram is schematic, not cadastral. Excludes rendered active road+0.75m and known stands/buildings/pit/water+0.5m; no translation. Divided into <=100m map patches only for continuous picking/local viewing, not real sector boundaries. Boundary simplification tolerance0.1m; tiny <4m2 remnants omitted. Source and excluded areas retained in accompanying evidence.

openingSource.notes: Official 2026 Dutch GP venue map legend explicitly identifies General Admission1–2; GA1 is on the outside bank, GA2 at the inside of the final section. This confirms admission category, not surveyed boundary coordinates or current ticket stock.

surfaceSource.notes: Unseated ground follows the existing GEDTM30 v1.2 source grid at actual vertical scale, subdivided into <=8m triangles. Mesh clearance0.04m avoids z-fighting; eye1.2m is a seated visitor. DTM is ~30m regional terrain, not a surveyed dune/terrace/fence. No fabricated rows, bank rise or height exaggeration. Estimated catch fences only on near-road public edges.
